column2: Two-factor authentication requires a second proof of identity to access an account.
Encryption protects message contents against unauthorized readers.
A password manager stores different credentials for each service.
Peer-to-peer systems allow computers to exchange files directly without a central server.
A server handles requests from several connected clients.
The DNS system resolves domain names into IP addresses.
Pizza is made with fermented dough, tomato sauce and cheese.
Rice cooks in hot water until it absorbs the liquid.
Vegetables can be roasted in the oven with olive oil.
Dogs need regular walks, vaccines and veterinary care.
Domestic cats spend much of the day sleeping.
Migratory birds travel long distances according to the season.
A car engine converts energy from fuel into motion.
A bicycle is powered by pedals and needs no fuel.
Sleeping at night helps recover energy and consolidate memories.
Frequent physical activity benefits the heart and muscles.
A tripod keeps a camera steady during long photographic exposures.
The lens aperture controls how much light enters the camera.
